integration: presentation_only; keys must be mapped to existing code by Codex

records.text: A new stable begins without a racing roster until you select a starting package.
This starting package is a one-time grant. Review its roster, equipment, facilities, and starting funds before confirming.
Recruitment offers are limited to the current market. Acquiring an offer removes it from the available list.
A racing unit uses one driver, two distinct owned draft beasts in a fixed order, and one chariot. Condition, availability, assignment and contract rules also apply.
Stable services are unavailable while a championship is active or its required settlement and final choices remain unfinished.
An expired contract requires a decision before the employee can continue under a renewed agreement.
Pending reward: this entitlement has not yet been credited to your career.
Credited reward: this entitlement has been settled and recorded.
This records your selection only. No gameplay bonus, Gold, recovery, unlock or Legacy Points are granted by this placeholder.
Three Legacy loadout slots are recorded, but equipping Legacy effects is not available in this version.
Official results and settlement determine championship awards. Race commentary is not an official result.

Restoration requires a compatible validated backup and explicit confirmation. Career-only JSON does not include race-session authority; use a complete championship backup when sessions are required. Unrelated careers and protected progress cannot be overwritten by confirmation alone.

review_notes: Candidate UI keys are new; require contextual binding. Pending/credited reward messages apply only to settlement entitlements, not placeholder choices. Legacy slots apply only to schema6.
